items.title: Frampton Comes Alive!
items.line: Released 15 January 1976, it spent 10 weeks at number 1 and was the best-selling album of the year.

items.title: Apple I
items.line: Apple was founded on 1 April 1976 and the Apple I went on sale that July for $666.66. The Byte Shop ordered 50, fully assembled.

items.title: Concorde
items.line: Scheduled Concorde flights began on 21 January 1976, and service to Washington Dulles started on 24 May at about Mach 2.

items.title: Nadia Comăneci
items.line: On 18 July 1976 in Montreal, the 14-year-old scored the first perfect 10 in Olympic gymnastics. The scoreboard couldn't show it and read 1.00.

items.title: The Bicentennial
items.line: On 4 July 1976 tall ships sailed into New York Harbor for Operation Sail and President Ford reviewed the fleet from the USS Wainwright.

items.title: Rocky
items.line: Opened on 3 December 1976. Stallone wrote it in about three and a half days, it cost around $1 million, and it won Best Picture.
